proposed_validation_assertion: Evidence-approved methodology ID/release/sha/authority/date/effective scope required
Every consumed file has checksum, vintage, source URL, intended scope and run freeze key
Target year only 2035/2040/2050; variant specifically approved
Case IDs unique per target year; 3/year in O26 draft; no PCA/K-Means
Weather weights finite and nonnegative; sum to one within approved numerical tolerance
Every selected case resolves to all required PECD/DFT/hydro profile IDs and hashes
Hour IDs no gaps/duplication; DST/leap/time-zone conventions explicitly approved
Weather/technology/zone mapping and allowed CF bounds; totals conservation
Project maturity and year-specific eligibility reference crosswalk signed
National offshore RES targets and hybrid status match approved source vintage
Every detailed bus assigned to exactly one connected zone; critical lines tracked
Physical reference signed; RMSE/N-1/LODF acceptance threshold defined
Each applicable interzone connection has summer/winter x two directions
All six classes (no-load, mesh, HVDC, capacity, impedance, PST) separately identifiable
Asset mapping and hourly/annual capacities, demands reconcile at source and target grains
Electric/H2 conversions energy units/efficiencies and no endogenous H2 line expansion
Five hydro classes with allowed inflows and implicit vs explicit DSR separation
Transmission candidates controllable DC market links regardless of physical AC/DC; both NTC effects
Study price year, real/nominal currency, WACC, discount/year-block and lifecycle coherent
Stage-1 real-only; Stage-2 residual sets with correct investment carryforward
Shared investment variable across weather cases and explicit weight objective
No endogenous 2035 storage; 2040/2050 trajectories and duration bounds confirmed
With/without investment portfolio cases have same exogenous conditions; both executed
Electrolyser load held equal to traced preexpansion hourly schedule
If optional OPF approved and executed, expansion cap no larger than LF portfolio
No KPI PASS before signed formulas, numeric examples and filter threshold
Numerical and structural tests actually executed with immutable fixtures/results
Separate independent human owner-approved QA and source decisions required for normative release
